items.title: Filter Numbers
items.description: Use the Number Filter on the home page to generate 4 combinations ignoring cold numbers over 100 draws, and add them to simulated draw checking.

images.caption: Enter the Number Filter page: 1. Select 'Non-repeating'; 2. Go to the Statistics page.
1. Select 100 draws; 2. Tap to sort by frequency; 3. Tap the latter half of numbers once to exclude them (tap again to set as banker, tap twice more to exclude).
1. Tap the center button directly to generate a set of non-repeating numbers; 2. Option to select 7 numbers per entry for multiple entries; 3. Tap the heart icon to save (can tap multiple times).
1. Enter the 4th Record/Draw Checking page to view saved numbers awaiting simulated checking; 2. The system will automatically execute draw checking tasks during this time.
